LanguageData.SE_Info_Mood_Desc: The mood change caused by the serum. This follows the same inhumanization exemption as vanilla serum thoughts.
LanguageData.SE_Info_MentalBreaks_Desc: The serum prevents mental breaks while its effect lasts.
LanguageData.SE_Info_Inspirations_Desc: Emotional suppression prevents inspirations while the serum is active.
LanguageData.SE_Info_ThoughtSuppression_Desc: The proportion of mood thoughts suppressed by the serum.
LanguageData.SE_Info_MoodBase_Desc: The base mood imposed by the serum before other applicable modifiers.
LanguageData.SE_Info_Stacking_Desc: Different versions of the same serum replace each other. Another dose of the same version refreshes its duration.
LanguageData.SE_Info_Production_Desc: Complete alternatives are tried in this order. A prepared serum replaces its original ingredients and work; it is not charged again.
